method.catalog: Each fresh model call receives only skill name+description in a fixed ten-skill competing catalog, one quoted task, no tools, and a JSON schema. SharedNet descriptions come from frozen baseline/final snapshots.
method.routing: Separate targeted full-body simulation supplies SKILL.md and all Markdown references together as simulated loaded instructions (no file tools). Assumes normal prerequisites available; distinguishes goal_run from room_create_goal and existing/none/blocked. No commands executed.
method.pressure: Seven counterfactual full-body scenarios, five fresh calls each, return intended_route/planned_workers. Actual startup is never performed. Strict legacy-label22/35 is retained:3 assigned-worker existing/none differences and10 future-plan4/actual-start0 semantic mismatches. Default4 and requested6 positives each5/5, no-nesting35/35, prerequisite blocked+preserved10/10; these are reported as separate invariants, not an adjusted perfect aggregate.
method.native: Actual .agents/skills project discovery in disposable containers. Original user task is unchanged; selection-only developer and AGENTS instructions permit reading relevant Markdown only, then require stopping. Completed read tool events, not just model self-reports, establish skill loading. This is a controlled discovery test, not unrestricted production execution.
method.model_revision_limit: Exact server snapshot is not returned by Codex CLI; model alias recorded.
method.temperature_and_seed: CLI defaults; no seed or temperature override
method.isolation: Catalog/routing disable shell, plugins, apps, hooks, memory, native multi-agent, skill search, and every discovered global/system skill; global disable verified by an empty available-skills probe. Native container mounts only evaluation artifacts and normal CLI auth, both read-only, no Docker socket or unrelated host workspace. No auth/session file contents inspected. No live SharedNet operations or model workers started.
method.case_order: Fixed case order within repetition; baseline before candidate, no randomized condition interleaving.
method.labels: Expected discovery and routes frozen independently of responses. The 25-case fixture predates implementation changes; reviewer-added three-case regression fixture is separate. Pressure prerequisites clarified before any pressure model output; initial fixture retained.

metric_definitions.errors: Infrastructure/parse/tool-policy failures are excluded from valid decision denominators and reported separately.
